ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell WindowStyle Option
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may use hidden windows to conceal malicious activity from the plain sight of users.
In some cases, windows that would typically be displayed when an application carries out an operation can be hidden
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*powershell.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WindowStyle.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Hidden.*")) AND  NOT ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Amazon\\\\WorkSpacesConfig\\\\Scripts\\\\.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\$PSScriptRoot\\\\Module\\\\WorkspaceScriptModule\\\\WorkspaceScriptModule.*")))
